stories.h: 2 Line trains swapped for buses across Lake Washington
stories.s: No light rail runs between International District/Chinatown and South Bellevue Saturday and Sunday while crews reinforce power-rail parts under the Mercer Island lids. Shuttles run every 10-15 minutes; Redmond-South Bellevue trains continue.

stories.h: Wind and heavy rain arrive tonight; outages possible
stories.s: Scattered showers give way to a stronger system after dark. Interior gusts of 30-40 mph peak around midnight, below advisory level but enough for power outages. Up to an inch of rain; showers linger Sunday.

stories.h: FAA ground stop snarls Sea-Tac with hundreds of delays
stories.s: A telecom outage led the FAA to halt flights nationwide Friday afternoon before lifting the stop. Sea-Tac logged 451 delays and 133 cancellations by late afternoon; Alaska warned recovery would take time and offered flexible rebooking.

stories.h: Seven-car I-5 crash in SeaTac kills one, injures seven
stories.s: Troopers say a speeding 23-year-old Auburn driver triggered the Thursday night pileup near South 200th Street, killing a 68-year-old van passenger. Northbound lanes were shut for about seven hours. Vehicular homicide charges are possible.

stories.h: One killed in Redmond shooting; two suspects fled
stories.s: A person shot Friday afternoon off Avondale Road NE near Woodinville-Duvall Road died en route to Harborview. Police are looking for two suspects but say they see no threat to the public. Tips: 425-556-2500.

coming.h: Seattle council final vote on 2027-28 budget
coming.s: Council members take up Mayor Wilson's roughly $9 billion budget plan, which closes a $175 million gap and makes meal-program funding permanent.
